title: Sorting our family’s stamps
passage:
Hi Mina,

Thanks for offering to sort the shoe box of stamps. We’re making two albums. The travel album records when our relatives sent their letters. The design album shows changes in how stamps looked. For the travel album, sort by the year on the postmark. For the design album, use the small printed issue year on the stamp itself. A stamp sometimes sat in a drawer for years before someone used it, so those dates need not agree.

Please leave stamps attached to any envelope that still has a readable postmark. We can use a photocopy of an attached stamp in the design album. If neither the stamp nor its envelope shows a year of use, put the envelope in the folder marked UNDATED rather than guessing from the design.

I left one example in the top tray: a stamp showing a heron and the issue year 1998 is still on an envelope. Its postmark clearly says 2003, although the town name is hard to read. It is the only copy we have of that design, and I would like it represented in both albums.

Aunt Claire
passageZh:
米娜，你好：

謝謝你願意整理那盒用鞋盒裝的郵票。我們要做兩本收藏冊。旅遊冊記下親友寄信的時間；設計冊則呈現郵票外觀的變化。整理旅遊冊時，請按郵戳上的年份分類；整理設計冊時，請看郵票本身印的小字發行年。有些郵票會在抽屜放好幾年才被用到，因此這兩個年份不一定相同。

如果信封上的郵戳仍可辨讀，請把郵票留在信封上。若郵票仍貼在信封上，設計冊可使用影本。若從郵票和信封都看不出使用年份，請把信封放進標示「日期不明」的資料夾，不要從圖案猜測。

我在最上層的托盤放了一個例子：一張印有鷺鳥、發行年為 1998 年的郵票還貼在信封上。郵戳清楚標示 2003 年，但地名難以辨讀。我們只有這一張該圖案的郵票，我希望兩本收藏冊都能收錄它。

克萊兒阿姨
